kla-01: Glory to Mother Kali. Whoever sings this aarti —
kla-02: finds supreme peace in the heart.
kla-03: At whose feet the three worlds tremble, moon-digit on the crown; Ganga in the matted hair; enemy-hosts vanish from the world.
kla-04: Eight-armed, beautiful, feet upon the corpse; skull-cup and sword; a garland of heads at the throat.
kla-05: You slew Mahishasura, destroyed Raktabija, threw down Shumbha and Nishumbha, and rescued all the gods.
kla-06: Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesha call when distress comes; Mother Durga Bhavani — You alone save.
kla-07: A red veil on the brow, three lovely eyes; sword and head in hand — giver of joy to devotees.
kla-08: Glory to Mother Kali — whoever sings this aarti finds supreme peace in the heart.
